verdict.rationale: Termius ships an in-product AI feature that turns plain-language descriptions into shell commands, which is a form of AI-generated suggestion. Its autocomplete draws on the user's own data (shell history, snippets, paths), but the docs do not describe it as AI. Nothing shows AI analyzing user data such as session logs or hosts to produce insights. Missing for 10: AI insights derived from the user's data (e.g. log or session analysis), evidence that suggestions use the user's data via AI, depth documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Termius generates the command using AI.
Termius can generate commands from plain-language descriptions.
